Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CURSOR c1 IS
 SELECT table_name, column_name
 FROM appl_rep_columns
 WHERE application = :banner.prog_name;

 -- Added by Kishore on 07/30/2015. SCR 18928
 cursor c2 is
 select test_id
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = :control_block_2.new_contract_id
 and :control_block_1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', profile_set_id, NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')) = NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')
 and :units.coll_date is not null
 and test_id not in
 (select test_id
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = :control_block_1.old_contract_id
 and :control_block_1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and DECODE(:control_block_1.old_contract_type,
 'RG', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and DECODE(:control_block_1.old_contract_type,
 'RG', profile_set_id, NVL(:control_block_1.old_profile_set_id, '@#')) = NVL(:control_block_1.old_profile_set_id, '@#')
 );
 -- End of change 

 t_rec_COUNT NUMBER;
 t_rec_extract_COUNT NUMBER;
 t_tot_recs NUMBER;
 t_chg_flg_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 t_coll_id_COUNT NUMBER;
 t_coll_id_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 t_last_checked_rec NUMBER := 1;
 t_unit_list VARCHAR2(500);
 t_warning_flag BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 t_test_found varchar2(1); -- Added by Kishore on 07/30/2015. SCR 18928
 t_test_count number; -- Added by Kishore on 07/30/2015. SCR 18928
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 07/30/2015. SCR 18928
 t_test_count := 0;
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 for c2rec in c2 loop
 begin
 select 'x'
 into t_test_found
 from utrs
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :units.unit_id
 and coll_date = :units.coll_date
 and test_id = c2rec.test_id
 and test_seq_no = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_test_found := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_test_found = 'x' then
 t_test_count := t_test_count + 1;
 end if;
 end loop;
 -- End of change

 if t_test_count = 0 then
 -- Added by Kishore on 07/30/2015. SCR 18928
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 
 LAST_RECORD;
 t_tot_recs := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 
 FOR i IN 1 .. t_tot_recs LOOP
 IF NVL(:units.change_flag, '*') = 'Y' THEN
 --t_chg_flg_cnt := t_chg_flg_cnt + 1; 
 IF LENGTH(:units.unit_id) = 13 AND
 NVL(:units.change_flag, '*') = 'Y' THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO t_coll_id_COUNT
 FROM valid_collection_agencies
 WHERE contract_id = :control_block_2.new_contract_id
 AND coll_id = SUBSTR(:units.unit_id, 1, 5);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 IF t_coll_id_count = 0 THEN
 :units.coll_id_flag := 'N';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 IF :units.coll_id_flag = 'Y' THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 t_coll_id_cnt := t_coll_id_cnt + 1;
 t_unit_list := t_unit_list || :units.unit_id || ', ';
 t_warning_flag := TRUE;
 END IF; -- :units.coll_id_flag
 t_last_checked_rec := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 END IF; --:units.change_flag
 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE'; -- Added by Kishore on 09/04/2015. IM 91
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 
 GO_RECORD(t_last_checked_rec);
 t_unit_list := ' - ' || RTRIM(t_unit_list, ', ');
 
 IF t_warning_flag = TRUE THEN
 show_error('9011', t_unit_list);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 FIRST_RECORD;
 
 FOR i IN 1 .. t_tot_recs LOOP
 IF NVL(:units.change_flag, '*') = 'Y' THEN
 -- Start of changes made by Kishore on 09/30/09
 BEGIN
 IF :new_batch_id IS NULL THEN
 --SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'MMDDYY-') SCR 18938
 SELECT TO_CHAR(:control_block_1.chp_sysdate, 'MMDDYY-') ||
 DECODE(:new_contract_type,
 'IN',
 'CB',
 :new_contract_type) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(batch_seq + 1), 4, '0')
 INTO :new_batch_id
 FROM chapters
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND
 --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE) SCR 18938
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10)
 FOR UPDATE of batch_seq;
 
 UPDATE chapters
 SET batch_seq = batch_seq + 1
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 insert_batch_inputs;
 ELSE
 update_batch_inputs;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('Invalid Chapter- Loc:1');
 END;
 
 -- Delete tests(not resulted) that are not part of new profile set id.
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND TRUNC(coll_date) = TRUNC(:coll_date)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND test_id NOT IN
 (SELECT test_id
 FROM contract_tests
 WHERE contract_id = :new_contract_id
 AND :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10)
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', profile_set_id, NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')) = NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')
 )
 AND result_status_1 is null; --- This condition was added for IM: 661
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 -----------------
 -- MLT 631
 -- Update profile set ID to NULL on tests (resulted) that are not part of new profile set id.
 BEGIN
 UPDATE UTRS
 SET profile_set_id = NULL
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND TRUNC(coll_date) = TRUNC(:coll_date)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND test_id NOT IN
 (SELECT test_id
 FROM contract_tests
 WHERE contract_id = :new_contract_id
 AND :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10)
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', profile_set_id, NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')) = NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')
 )
 AND result_status_1 is not null; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 ---

 -- Update profile set ID to new set ID on tests that are common for both contracts. Doesn't matter if tests are resulted or not..
 --
 if :control_block_2.new_contract_type= 'RG' and :control_block_2.new_profile_set_id IS NOT NULL then
 UPDATE utrs
 set profile_set_id = :control_block_2.new_profile_set_id
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND TRUNC(coll_date) = TRUNC(:coll_date)
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND test_id IN
 (SELECT test_id
 FROM contract_tests
 WHERE contract_id = :new_contract_id
 AND :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10)
 AND profile_set_id = :control_block_2.new_profile_set_id
 );
 
 end if;
 --
 
 --
 :batch_id := :new_batch_id;
 :contract_id := :new_contract_id;
 :received_date := :new_rcvdcoll_date;
 --
 insert_utrs;
 update_rgt_tubes;
 
 IF :new_contract_type = 'TS' THEN
 upd_test_serv_units;
 END IF;
 -- END of changes made by Kishore on 09/30/09
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO t_rec_count
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id
 AND qc_test_flag IS NOT NULL
 AND qc_test_date IS NOT NULL;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 IF t_rec_COUNT > 0 AND :units.change_flag = 'Y' THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE units
 SET qc_test_flag = NULL, qc_test_date = NULL
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO t_rec_extract_count
 FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id
 AND extract_date IS NOT NULL;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 IF t_rec_extract_count > 0 AND :units.change_flag = 'Y' THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE utrs
 SET extract_date = NULL
 WHERE unit_id = :units.unit_id
 AND extract_date IS NOT NULL;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 
 t_last_checked_rec := :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD;
 END IF; -- :units.change_flag
 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE'; -- Added by Kishore on 09/04/2015. IM 91
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 
 GO_RECORD(t_last_checked_rec);
 
 FOR c1rec IN c1 LOOP
 do_updates(UPPER(c1rec.table_name),
 UPPER(c1rec.column_name),
 UPPER(:control_block_2.new_contract_id),
 UPPER(:control_block_1.old_contract_id),
 UPPER(:control_block_2.new_batch_id),
 UPPER(:control_block_1.old_batch_id));
 check_package_failure;
 END LOOP;
 end if; -- if t_test_count = 0 then -- Added by Kishore on 07/30/2015. SCR 18928

 COMMIT;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_batch_inputs
is
begin
--
-- If the new contract is 'CU' then generate the contract_suffix
-- else insert with contract_suffix = null.
--
 
 insert into batch_inputs (batch_id,
 chapter_id,
 contract_id,
 received_date,
 checkin_user_id,
 insert_dats,
 profile_seq_no,
 profile_set_id)
 values
 (:new_batch_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :new_contract_id,
 :new_rcvdcoll_date,
 :banner.user_id,
 sysdate,
 :new_profile_seq_no,
 :new_profile_set_id);
exception
 when others
 then
 message('Problem in batch_inputs');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_UTRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE insert_utrs
IS
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 

 --
 -- Insert those tests in UTRS which are part of the new contract but
 -- not of the old profile.
 --
 INSERT INTO utrs 
 (
 unit_id
 , coll_date
 , chapter_id
 , test_seq_no
 , test_id
 , insert_dats
 , insert_user_id
 , program_id
 , profile_set_id 
 )
 SELECT :unit_id,
 :coll_date,
 :global.chapter_id,
 1,
 test_id,
 SYSDATE,
 :global.banner_user,
 'TSUOCON',
 profile_set_id
 FROM contract_tests
 WHERE contract_id = :new_contract_id
 AND :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10)
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and DECODE(:control_block_2.new_contract_type,
 'RG', profile_set_id, NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#')) = NVL(:control_block_2.new_profile_set_id, '@#') 
 AND :coll_date IS NOT NULL
 AND test_id NOT IN
 (SELECT test_id
 FROM contract_tests
 WHERE contract_id = :old_contract_id
 and :control_block_1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and DECODE(:control_block_1.old_contract_type,
 'RG', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id
 and DECODE(:control_block_1.old_contract_type,
 'RG', profile_set_id, NVL(:control_block_1.old_profile_set_id, '@#')) = NVL(:control_block_1.old_profile_set_id, '@#')
 );
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Problem in insert_utrs...Contact Systems');
END;

procedure upd_test_serv_units
is
begin
-- Manipulation of TEST_SERVICE_UNITS table :-
-- If the new contract expects electronic mail then,
-- delete the record which was inserted at the time of tube checkin.
-- Update the record corresponding to the new contract. Insert a new
-- record if this record is not present.
-- else
-- update the old contract record with new information. (The
-- SQL%NOTFOUND check is a redundant check for this case.)
--
 if :new_edi_input_ind = 'Y'
 then
 delete from test_service_units
 where contract_id = :old_contract_id
 and os_unit_id = :os_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and batch_id = :old_batch_id;
 end if;
--
 update test_service_units
 set contract_id = :new_contract_id,
 batch_id = :new_batch_id,
 ts_batch_id = decode(:new_edi_input_ind,'Y',
 ts_batch_id,:new_batch_id)
 where contract_id = decode(:new_edi_input_ind,'Y',
 :new_contract_id,:old_contract_id)
 and os_unit_id = :os_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and batch_id = decode(:new_edi_input_ind,'Y',:new_batch_id,
 :old_batch_id);
--
 if SQL%NOTFOUND
 then
 insert into test_service_units (contract_id,
 chapter_id,
 os_unit_id,
 ts_batch_id,
 batch_id)
 values
 (:new_contract_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :os_unit_id,
 :new_batch_id,
 :new_batch_id);
 end if;
exception
 when others
 then
 message('Problem in upd_test_serv_units...Contact Systems');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_CONTRACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_contract(p_contract_id IN VARCHAR2,
 p_contract_type OUT VARCHAR2,
 p_company OUT VARCHAR2,
 p_edi_input_ind OUT VARCHAR2,
 p_profile_seq_no OUT NUMBER) is
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :control_block_1.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 SELECT contract_type, company, NVL(edi_input_ind, 'N'), profile_seq_no
 INTO p_contract_type, p_company, p_edi_input_ind, p_profile_seq_no
 FROM contracts 
 WHERE contract_id = p_contract_id
 AND DECODE(contract_type, 'RG', :GLOBAL.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id -- MLT 570
 AND :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10);

 
 -- MLT 570 (only for regional contracts, check rgt_contract_chapters table as well)
 IF p_contract_type = 'RG' THEN 
 SELECT 1 
 INTO l_dummy
 FROM rgt_contract_chapters
 WHERE contract_id = p_contract_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND :control_block_1.chp_sysdate BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10);
 
 END IF;

 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
END;

procedure validate_rcvd_date (p_contract_id in VARCHAR2,
 p_received_date in date)
is
 dummy_x VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 select max('x')
 into dummy_x
 from batch_inputs b
 where contract_id = p_contract_id
 and trunc(received_date) = trunc(p_received_date) -- Commented by Kishore on 08/21/2015. IM 73 (uncommented for IM 356)
 --and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, received_date)) = trunc(p_received_date) -- Added by Kishore on 08/21/2015. IM 73 (IM 356)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and 0 < (select count(*) 
 from units 
 where batch_id = b.batch_id);
 
 if dummy_x is null then
 show_error('1171');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_UPDATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure do_updates(p_table_name in varchar2,
 p_column_name in varchar2,
 p_new_contract_id in varchar2,
 p_old_contract_id in varchar2,
 p_old_batch_id in varchar2,
 p_new_batch_id in varchar2) is
v_cursorid integer;
v_rowupdate integer;
t_count number;
v_updatestmt varchar2(500);
TABLE_NOT_EXIST EXCEPTION;
PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(TABLE_NOT_EXIST, -00942);

BEGIN
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_count
 from all_tab_columns
 where table_name = p_table_name
 and column_name = 'BATCH_ID';
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 v_cursorid := DBMS_SQL.OPEN_CURSOR;
 if t_count > 0 then
 v_updatestmt := 'UPDATE '||p_table_name||' SET '||p_column_name||
 ' = '||IN_QUOTES(p_new_contract_id)||', batch_id = '||
 IN_QUOTES(p_new_batch_id)||
 ' WHERE contract_id = '||in_quotes(p_old_contract_id)||
 ' AND batch_id = '||in_quotes(p_old_batch_id);
 else
 v_updatestmt := 'UPDATE '||p_table_name||' SET '||p_column_name||
 ' = '||IN_QUOTES(p_new_contract_id)||
 ' WHERE contract_id = '||in_quotes(p_old_contract_id);
 end if;
 --message(v_updatestmt);pause; 
 DBMS_SQL.PARSE(v_cursorid, v_updatestmt, 2);
 v_rowupdate := DBMS_SQL.EXECUTE(v_cursorid);
 DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(v_cursorid);
EXCEPTION
 when TABLE_NOT_EXIST THEN
 Message('Msg: Cannot access database tables - '||p_table_name);pause;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(v_cursorid);
 Message(SQLERRM);pause;
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
END;
